column1: # gates/waves.tsv — the wave registry. Tab-separated: wave <TAB> tasks <TAB> gates
# WAVE NUMBERING: these are R4's GATE waves 0–6, the same numbering
# follows that table wherever it names a task; tasks it does not name are
# placed by their dependencies and their track. Task -> node and node states
# come from the board itself: each node's prd.md frontmatter carries `task:`
# and `state:`, and gates/wave-status.sh reads both from there.
# Gate commands are `|`-separated and run FROM THE REPO ROOT. A command
# prefixed `external ` names a script owned by another node (everything under
# tests/): the runner invokes it, and gates/selftest.sh reports it as
# unverified-by-contract rather than failing on it, because the --selftest
# contract cannot be imposed on a file this node must not edit.
# An EMPTY gates cell is legal only while the wave is PENDING. The moment
# every task in the row is `done` at its node, the wave is ARMED and an empty
# cell is RED — "this wave finished and nobody wrote its gate" is exactly the
# failure that produced this node. Each wave's own tasks add their gate here.
